alt: A short film with no voice. A room with a window. Two small block figures with white eyes, one amber and one light blue, stand on either side of a little digital clock that reads MAR. They lean toward each other and pulse happily, and the clock flips month after month, APR, MAY, JUN, JUL, AUG, SEP, OCT, with a little hop each time. When it reaches NOV both turn to the camera with narrowed eyes. The text stays: if someone sent you this: 'catch up soon' is not a plan. Pick a real day.
